arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Kerrigan cited a recent case suggesting an assignee status in law.
Mr. Lamken argued the California Labor Code does not violate due process for three reasons.
Mr. Seideman responded to a question about the client's actions after payment was withheld.
